summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG with persistent player progression across authored and simulation-built levels. Place sims assemble local layouts, populations and hazards around shared player, NPC, loot, combat and UI systems; paired thresholds connect routes, now including Level 11's Infinite City. Shared feed/status logic turns notices and player-state thresholds into the HUD message stack, while place and NPC managers avoid most work when no players are present or agents are far away.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 / The Lobby, yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells carry fixtures, containers, shifting walls and hunters.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored spaces plus Level 2.1's simulated rooms, zones, agents and set pieces.
places/level3, places/gamma (3D) - Electrical Station and Base Gamma; seeded layouts, hazards, agents, traders, generators and lifts; Gamma includes Marlo the smith.
places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office; office structure and residents, cubicles, claimed homes, coolers, vending, lift/stairs and Base Omega.
places/level5 (3D) - Terror Hotel; authored hotel cells and sim-managed residents, creatures and interactions, including Samantha the psychic tuxedo cat.
places/level6, places/level61, places/level11 (3D) - Lights Out and Snackrooms connect to Level 11, The Infinite City: generated city streets, canal, tower/skydeck, interactive props, taxi and skiff.
places/level7 (3D) - Thalassophobia; flooded Floating House, Seawatch, Fort Surrender, sea floor and diving bell.
places/debug (3D) - Separate dark atmosphere and spawn for debugging.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares player actions, camera, player template and HUD; Backspace opens the main menu.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain; locomotion/control precede swim, interactions and gameplay handlers, then critter, menu and view3.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; scripts/view3.js toggles player.state.tp.
places/<place>/config.yaml + sim.js + cells - place setup and placements; sims build local layouts and tick/update local behavior, generally skipping work while their place is empty.
sim.js - world cadence and onOutOfBounds referee; players return true for normal respawn, creatures with state.home return home, others are destroyed for manager respawn.
places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - Level 6.1 assembler; lay() replaces l61-prefixed scene roots and layExtra() adds mall, Camp Amber and staff pieces.
places/level11/sim.js - onSpawn builds the Infinite City under l11-prefixed IDs; city props bind level11-use.js and its taxi/skiff bind their vehicle controllers.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/*-ui.js - HUD and overlays; ui.js mounts feed, inventory and gameplay panels plus builders-only LAGSCOPE and transfer cards.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait and heading for player and M.E.G. NPC chains; scripts/lib/body3.js supplies weapon animation and rowing IK.
scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js + data - per-level grids, zones and layouts reused by simulations, geometry, zone labels and creature navigation.
scripts/lib/level3.js through level7.js + path helpers - level plans, zone/route queries and navigation reused by place systems and creatures.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.
scripts/lib/clothes.js, scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/clothes data, scripts/mat-cloth.js - seeded looks, rendered bodies and garments; art/critter-cute/build.py produces cute head meshes.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + level data - shared item pools, rolls, remains, parsing and container helpers; art/props/build.py supplies modeled lockers/fridges.
scripts/lib/condition.js + condition.yml and scripts/lib/stats.js - weapon/armor condition and derived handling/carry values used by player.js, clothes.js, loot-ui.js and NPC dialogue.
scripts/lib/feed.js + scripts/feed-ui.js - state-backed message feed; scripts/stats.js supplies legacy notices and status/discovery messages, ui.js renders it.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level61/sim.js - cadence and tick; places/level11/sim.js - cadence, onSpawn, update.
scripts/ambient-anim.js - onSpawn, update; scripts/lib/ambient.js - fan, fanHousing, cable and DRIP, DUST, MIST, SPORES, BUBBLES, RIPPLE builders/effects.
scripts/lib/level21.js - grid, room, zone, exit and height queries/constants; scripts/lib/maze21path.js - canPass21, stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/l21-use.js - updateSchedule, ears, update; scripts/level21-geo.js - geometry; scripts/lib/chatter.js - tickChatter, CHATTER.
scripts/l61-use.js - MENUS, ears, landed, takeItem, vendExpire, ready, expire; scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - layExtra, faceling, person, PEOPLE, FACELING_IDS.
scripts/level11-car.js and scripts/level11-boat.js - ears, control begin/end, input and update; scripts/level11-use.js - ears for interactive city props.
scripts/lib/condition.js - CAP, band, bandColor, wMul, jamChance, drMul, wear and repair helpers; scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS and recruitment/order/weapon APIs.
scripts/lib/feed.js - LIFE, PLACE_NAMES, pushFeed, watch; scripts/feed-ui.js - feedUi; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - speciesOf, bodyModel, headModel, critterSpec, rewear and NPC appearance helpers.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, clothing and karma/rep; also transient movement/combat state.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags and sheet state; initialize/migrate/spend points; derive carry and combat values, and tick companion perks.
scripts/craft.js - craft actions, payout redemption and hunger/thirst drain; scripts/swim.js owns swimming/underwater/breath and swim session controls, timer and audio.
scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js own focus, loot and sit state; scripts/lockpick.js owns pick state and pins; seats own occupancy.
scripts/talk.js owns dialogue/shop UI state and NPC rapport, gifts, trade and rep effects; scripts/lib/rep.js owns karma and per-group reputation calculation/writes.
scripts/meg-agent.js - NPC routines, attributes/nerve, loadout, combat, fear, cover, idle social coordination and transient movement/path recovery.

scripts/lib/companion.js - companion setup, eligibility, perks, carried-weight bonus, loyalty and weapon handoff; NPC state.follow/cperk/loyal/cmd/cstance and player.session.comp hold companion state/timers.
scripts/lib/feed.js + scripts/stats.js - player.state.feed entries and player.state.disc discoveries; stats session tracks copied notice timestamps and one-shot threshold flags.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js behavior order: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/horde, then critter, main-menu and view3.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
world.config.yaml Backspace → scripts/main-menu.js; menu actions and scripts/ui.js render menu/creator; menu hides player and supplies ctx.view.camera backdrop.
Engine out-of-bounds event → sim.js onOutOfBounds: player returns true for normal respawn; creature with state.home is repositioned there, otherwise destroyed for manager respawn.

Level threshold trigger → scripts/level-door.js maps pair IDs, writes arrival state.clipKind and calls companion.bring → nearby non-waiting followers cross; player.js consumes clipKind into state.xfer.kind.
Level 11's l11-to-l61 and l11-from-l61 IDs ↔ level-door.js pair mappings ↔ Level 6.1's l61-to-l11/l11-from-l61; level11-use.js also teleports users between lobby and rooftop skydeck.

places/level21/sim.js → scripts/lib/level21.js layout, level21-geo.js geometry and chatter.js exchanges; hounds.js uses maze21path.js; l21-use.js handles set pieces and Edge Smilers; ambient-anim.js handles state.anim props.
scripts/player.js NPC kill → scripts/lib/witness.js markKill records witnesses and corpse state → scripts/lib/rep.js repKill writes player karma and witnessed faction standings.
scripts/talk.js gifts/fair trades → scripts/lib/rep.js repKind/repTrade; repDisc/isHated inform shop prices/refusal; repLine supplies dialogue prompt; stats-ui.js reads karma/rep.

scripts/talk-ui.js exposes Recruit and follower orders → scripts/talk.js dispatches talkdo → scripts/lib/companion.js validates/adopts/orders/transfers weapons; normal dialogue join/leave also adopts/dismisses.
scripts/meg-agent.js follows state.follow and supplies follower combat → scripts/lib/stats.js npcMul scales damage; scripts/stats.js ticks companion medic/mule/mechanic perks.
s.notice and status thresholds → scripts/stats.js copies notices and calls scripts/lib/feed.js pushFeed/watch → player.state.feed and player.state.disc; scripts/ui.js renders through feed-ui.js.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light state and red-zone variants; Level 5 cells also carry portal and quest props.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look scripts - office structure and varied cubicle/prop treatments share the office plan; Level 7 has dedicated ocean, room and furnishing variants.
scripts/l4-office.js + l4-office-geo.js - cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambience, tasks and rewards; l4-home.js handles claims and amenities.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies combat and idle social behavior.
scripts/lib/craft.js + craft data - recipe category, costs, skill, bench, batch size and item family vary per recipe.

places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js - room blocks share generated hall/room structure; room type, zone height, lighting, decor and loot vary by authored grid data and deterministic hashes.

places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js + l61-use/staff/diner/jukebox scripts - food-court venues share service systems with varying menus and Faceling roles; rotunda, dining terraces and Camp Amber use distinct set pieces.

scripts/level11-use.js + level11-car.js + level11-boat.js - generated city props vary by state.kind; the taxi and skiff each share a controllable vehicle pattern with distinct movement and exit handling.
migrationNotes: Level 2.1 grid is 30×30 at 4 m per cell (120 m square); keep level21.js passability/room zones, maze21path.js traversal, sim geometry/hound routing aligned, and roofAt in place state so ceiling checks survive ticks.

Keep paired arrival IDs aligned: Level 2 ↔ Level 2.1 (l2-from-l21/l21-from-l2), Level 6 ↔ Level 6.1 (l6-from-l61/l61-from-l6; wire trigger l6-wire-trip), and Level 6.1 ↔ Level 11 (l61-to-l11/l11-from-l61). Level 11 elevator uses y=44.2 and y=0.25; world bottom is -30.

Weapon condition is player.state.cnd_<weapon>; garment condition lives in player.state.look.cnd keyed by garment token and shared across same kind/colour copies; keep clothes.yml pattern IDs implemented by mat-cloth.js.

Level 6.1 lay() destroys and replaces root IDs prefixed l61-; keep local service/menu/pickup/tray IDs and coordinates aligned with level61-extra.js and use handlers; model forward may be asset-specific.

Companion fields are NPC state.follow/cperk/loyal/cmd/cstance (plus waitAt and weapon handoff fields); player.session.comp holds perk timers and player.state.carryBonus is companion-derived, distinct from carryExtra.

Feed entries are player.state.feed [{t, at, k}], capped at six and displayed for 7 seconds; player.state.disc is comma-separated discovered place IDs, and scripts/stats.js owns the notice/status watcher cadence and session flags.
